counting_method: Page-aware pdftotext extraction. Start markers are excluded and end markers are exclusive. ASCII lexical words are counted after line-break hyphen repair; sentences use terminal punctuation; paragraphs use extracted blank-line blocks. Page 2 cover letter and pages 44-45 references are excluded from the 42-page technical denominator. Mechanical counts require visual reconciliation before validation.
ambiguities: Display equations, figure labels, table cells, bullets, and multi-line variable definitions can inflate mechanical paragraph or sentence counts.
Introduction includes the task decomposition and roadmap on pages 5-6 because they complete the gap-to-body handoff.
Model establishment covers several named leaf, physiology, arrangement, branch, and tree submodels under one continuous body block.
Discussion combines strengths, limitations, and forward extensions and is retained as strengths-limitations.
